summary: Retested the mobile preview at 375x667 and verified app loading plus backend root and sync contracts. Workspace flow reaches the modal, but the modal Save securely control is rendered outside the viewport, blocking workspace creation and all downstream UI flows.

ui_bugs.issue: At 375x667, the Save securely control is outside the viewport and Playwright cannot tap it, even with force=True. This blocks creating a workspace from the required mobile viewport.

integration_issues.flow: Workspace -> account -> expense -> ledger -> spending -> sync
integration_issues.issue: Blocked at workspace save due to modal layout; downstream flows were not claimable in this run.

issues: Bottom-sheet content exceeds the 667px mobile viewport; primary action is not tappable without layout/keyboard handling.

action_items: Constrain the bottom-sheet content to the mobile viewport and handle keyboard/scrolling so Save securely is always tappable; add testIDs to modal inputs and save/cancel controls.
Retest the complete flow after the modal layout fix.
critical_code_review_comments: FinanceProvider.sync uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL, while the requested contract names EXPO_BACKEND_URL; standardize the key or document the intentional project key.
The app has no explicit loading or error feedback for sync failure; failed responses silently leave the pending state.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_review_tx through POST /api/sync for contract verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: At 375x667, clear localStorage first. App loads and create-workspace opens the sheet, but Save securely is below viewport. Backend GET /api/ and POST /api/sync pass.
rca_of_issue: The modal sheet is bottom-aligned with fixed padding and no keyboard-aware scrolling or max-height. On the short viewport, its primary action falls below the visible area; the prior FAB issue was fixed but this new/remaining modal layout blocker prevents the required flow.
test_credentials: No auth flow exists; credentials file is only an empty template.
